title: Agritech Product Manager
description: Leads product strategy for agritech platforms, prioritizes features for farmers and agribusinesses, coordinates between engineering and field teams.
day_in_the_life: Morning: review farmer feedback and telemetry dashboards; Afternoon: roadmap planning and stakeholder calls; Evening: prioritization and analytics review

title: Agricultural Data Scientist
description: Builds predictive models for crop yield forecasting and advises on data-driven interventions for improved productivity.
day_in_the_life: Data collection from sensors, model training, field validation, meeting agronomists

title: Farm Manager
description: Oversees daily farm operations, supervises workers, manages crop schedules and logistics.
day_in_the_life: Start early with field inspection, manage staff, coordinate inputs, supervise harvesting

title: Architect
description: Designs buildings and coordinates with engineers and clients to deliver functional and aesthetic structures.
day_in_the_life: Client meetings, design reviews, site visits, coordination with consultants

title: Interior Designer
description: Creates interior layouts and selects finishes, lighting, and furniture for residential and commercial spaces.
day_in_the_life: Client consultations, mood board creation, vendor coordination

title: 3D Visualizer
description: Produces photorealistic renders and walkthroughs for architectural presentations.
day_in_the_life: Modeling scenes, texturing, rendering, producing presentation assets

title: Software Engineer
description: Develops backend services, APIs, and collaborates on product features and system design.
day_in_the_life: Code implementation, code reviews, standups, debugging

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Builds end-to-end web applications including frontend UIs and backend services.
day_in_the_life: Implement UI features, integrate APIs, debug production issues, deploy releases

title: Data Scientist
description: Develops machine learning models to extract insights from data and supports product decisions.
day_in_the_life: Data cleaning, model building, experimentation, presenting insights

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Builds and maintains CI/CD pipelines and automates infrastructure for reliability.
day_in_the_life: Monitoring systems, script automation, deploys, incident response

title: Precision Farming Specialist
description: Implements sensor-driven precision farming techniques and advises on variable rate inputs.
day_in_the_life: Field sensor calibration, data analysis, advising farmers

title: Drone Pilot (Agriculture)
description: Operates agricultural drones for spraying and mapping and analyzes imagery for insights.
day_in_the_life: Pre-flight checks, field operations, process imagery, maintenance

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Deploys ML models to production and optimizes inference latency and pipelines.
day_in_the_life: Model optimization, deployment, monitoring, collaborating with data scientists

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Designs cloud-native solutions and manages cloud infrastructure and costs.
day_in_the_life: Designing infra, cost optimization, deployments, security reviews

title: Landscape Architect
description: Designs outdoor public spaces and coordinates planting and hardscape details.
day_in_the_life: Site surveys, client meetings, planting plans, vendor coordination
